scope: Explicit owner read-only admission path diagnostics; full actual Prepare validation remains pending and no approval is created.
riskAnalysis: Read-only owner UI exposes finite phase/code and validated manifest hash/limits, never raw errors or provider data. Exact fresh task/runtime/sequence fences remain required. No registration, approval persistence, reservation, activation, inference, publication or existing-cache overwrite. Preserve previous unconfirmed preparation and all server history.

threatModel.assets: Existing approval cache, exact source/runtime/task/sequence scope and sanitized owner evidence.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Authenticated owner frontend versus existing server read-only status/manifest routes and local immutable selection.
threatModel.abuseCases: Old-runtime selection, stale task, active cached approval, private error echo, forged manifest bounds, scope changes during awaits or implied spending permission.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact selection/task filtering, fence after every await, fixed status/manifest routes only, finite safe errors, validated model/limits/authority booleans, output hash only and no storage writes.

rollback: Restore prior qualified Preview and preserve existing sequence selection, approval journals, failed preparation and accounting. No rollback grants paid authority.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Incomplete, refused or malformed output remains rejected; no fake artifact.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact saved sequence and fresh task must match current runtime and captured fence. No wildcard release recovery.
negativePaths.concurrency: UI busy guard and captured fence suppress duplicate checks or late scope changes; backend authoritative checks unchanged.
negativePaths.cancellation: Revocation and emergency stop remain authoritative; no retry after failure.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Cancel before/inside/after child, await actual termination/disposal; unknown or failed cleanup stays blocked. Remote authorization cannot outlive original authority.
negativePaths.api-outage: Safe finite phase/code only; no raw errors, retry or authority mutation.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Existing owner-only status/manifest routes enforce authority; UI does not register, prepare, activate or execute.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Read-only manifest may deny audit headroom/budget/sequence; finite codes preserved and no reservation is created.
negativePaths.partial-execution: A complete model response is not a preserved implementation artifact; only actual accepted stage receipts reach downstream roles.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing owner UI and existing read-only controller routes; no backend change.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No new dependencies or credential access.
proactiveReview.threats: Raw error leaks, wrong runtime, unintended registration or approval.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Network, stale scope, status denial, manifest denial or invalid manifest remain unconfirmed without retries.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Executed success/denial/network/fence/stale selection/cached approval UI fixtures; no authority-changing request.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Parent and Auditor cross-review Work-authored UI change; author tests are not independent acceptance.
proactiveReview.recovery: Read-only diagnosis exposes actual denial phase before any later explicit Prepare; no repeating unknown registration.
proactiveReview.readiness: 114 focused UI checks passed; final separate QA and Auditor review and frozen STRICT/remote qualification required. Read-only success expressly leaves full approval validation pending; no paid authority.
